name: Bafna Pharmaceuticals Ltd
tagline: Small-cap pharma formulations exporter with decent (not exceptional) returns trading at a rich ~90x trailing P/E - valuation doesn't support the fundamentals.
business_overview: Bafna Pharmaceuticals (incorporated 1981) manufactures finished pharmaceutical formulations, with over 336 licensed formulations and 78 globally registered products. Seeded via an untrusted X tip (@rajuidesai, bullish, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_narrative: Returns are middling for a pharma formulations business (ROCE ~11.9%, ROE ~12.3%) - decent but not exceptional, and not obviously margin-expanding or compounding based on the data found this pass. The global product registrations (78) give some regulatory-moat character, but nothing found points to a specific named inflection (new large export contract, capacity step-change, margin re-rating already in motion) that would justify the current multiple.
